# Video Moment Finder

> Video Moment Finder is a SaaS tool that lets you process videos and find specific moments using semantic search. Upload a video or paste a YouTube URL, then search by text description or example image to jump straight to matching timestamps.

- Public REST API, CLI, and Claude-compatible remote MCP connector for indexing videos and searching them by text or image
- Primary documented agent flow: direct upload, wait for indexing, search by text
- Additional capabilities include YouTube ingestion and image-based similarity search
- Powered by multimodal Qwen3-VL embeddings; 30-minute maximum video length; credit-based pricing with a free starter credit

## Links

- [Homepage](https://www.videomomentfinder.com/): Product landing page with feature overview and direct-upload demo
- [Skill File](https://www.videomomentfinder.com/skill.md): Canonical public agent bootstrap describing OAuth 2.0 + PKCE, the supported happy path, API host, and REST/MCP tool names — read this first if you are integrating an agent
- [Claude Connector](https://www.videomomentfinder.com/connectors/claude): Walkthrough for approving the Claude-compatible remote MCP server at api.videomomentfinder.com/mcp, including the four tools exposed (upload_video, get_video_status, list_videos, search_video)
- [Developers](https://www.videomomentfinder.com/developers): Human-readable REST API and CLI overview with setup and example prompts
- [OpenAPI Schema](https://api.videomomentfinder.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable API contract for the public REST interface
- [Swagger UI](https://api.videomomentfinder.com/docs): Interactive API reference
- [Pricing](https://www.videomomentfinder.com/pricing): Credit-based pricing, free starter credit (1 video up to 30 minutes), and Starter/Pro/Developer Pack details
- [Support](https://www.videomomentfinder.com/support): FAQ covering supported sources, processing times, credit behavior, data handling, and contact information
